keyword_evidence: Marketplace and retail SERPs support Celtic Tree of Life rugs, Tree of Life welcome mats, Yggdrasil rugs, Celtic knot rugs and Tree of Life doormats. B040 separates highly similar products by visible style: sunset Celtic border, abstract rainbow tree, stained-glass landscape, ancient knotwork roots, emerald glow, monochrome line art, teal-gold knotwork, sepia Celtic knot, jeweled Celtic frame and rainbow mosaic.
buyer_summary: B040 buyers include Celtic decor shoppers, spiritual home decor buyers, nature lovers, Yggdrasil/Norse symbol fans, housewarming gift buyers and people looking for bold tree-themed rugs for living rooms, bedrooms or entryways.
purchase_concerns: Whether design reads Celtic/Yggdrasil, color palette match, custom text expectation, size fit, room placement, memory foam or low pile feel, non-slip backing, easy-clean expectations and avoiding near-duplicate Tree of Life visuals.
